title: Donated tokens are never deposited into vaults
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  The `HyperEvmVault` contract has to use the asset balances of the `VaultEscrow`s in the share's price calculation to handle tokens being received from the system contract. In normal the balances should not exceed the `$.requestSum.assets` value. The problem is that in case of donation to the vaults, the excess balance increases the shares price but can not be distributed, i.e. it is locked on the vaults.
